text: During the seizure, alongside any rescue medicine, I would use topical magnesium chloride and consider topical DMSO with a known-genuine CBD preparation (a lot of CBD is fake or very dilute). Seizures come in all different types, and we have no study on whether CBD could be a rescue remedy for a seizure (just anecdotes), even though we do have studies showing long-term effectiveness to prevent them: Purified oral CBD is approved for the seizures of Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, Dravet syndrome and tuberous sclerosis complex.
reader: someone with a person who is having, or about to have, a seizure from MDMA or a psychedelic overdose, which is generalized, and who wants to know what can stop it now

sentences.s: During the seizure, alongside any rescue medicine, I would use topical magnesium chloride and consider topical DMSO with a known-genuine CBD preparation (a lot of CBD is fake or very dilute).
sentences.payoff: the reader learns what Joel adds once the seizure has started, alongside the rescue medicine if they have it, and that these are for during the seizure, not for the warning stage just described
sentences.follows: the paragraph before is the warning stage, so "During the seizure" turns back to the seizure itself, and "alongside any rescue medicine" ties it to the rescue paragraph before that

sentences.s: Seizures come in all different types, and we have no study on whether CBD could be a rescue remedy for a seizure (just anecdotes), even though we do have studies showing long-term effectiveness to prevent them: Purified oral CBD is approved for the seizures of Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, Dravet syndrome and tuberous sclerosis complex.

checked.point: For focal seizures outside those syndromes, the evidence is mixed, but still long-term.
checked.found: this reader's seizure is generalized ("Drug induced seizures are generalized processes", University of Calgary pearl), and that the evidence is long-term is said in the sentence before
checked.still_needed: no: it tells this reader about a kind of seizure they are not facing

checked.still_needed: yes: the point that they add to the rescue medicine, not replace it

placement: P3, where it was, now after the warning-stage paragraph Joel put before it: "During the seizure" marks the turn from the warning stage back to the seizure, and "alongside any rescue medicine" ties it to the rescue paragraph before the warning paragraph
